∀ {d : ℕ} {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (f : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → ℝ) (L σ R : ℝ)
  (T : OracleTemplate.BirchSgd.Tree),
  T.WellFormed →
    ∀ (m : ℕ → ℕ),
      T.IsMainBranch m →
        ∀ (μ : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → Ω))
          (g : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d → Ω → OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) (gamma : ℝ)
          (x0 : OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d),
          0 < L →
            LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SmoothObjective f L →
              LongTails.Setups.StochasticSmoothAndConvex.IsStochasticGradient (OracleTemplate.Rennala.Point d) Ω (↑μ) f
                  g σ →
                (∀ (c : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Measure.map (fun η => η c) ↑P = ↑μ) →
                  LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.SampleIndependent T m gamma x0 g ↑P →
                    LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.ReprContained T m →
                      LongTails.Setups.BirchSgd.DistanceBounded T m R →
                        ∀ (k : ℕ),
                          ∃ p ≤ k,
                            ↑k - ↑p ≤ R ∧
                              ∃ I ⊆ Finset.Ico p k,
                                ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω),
                                    ‖T.vertex gamma x0 g η (m k) - T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m k)‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P ≤
                                  2 * gamma ^ 2 * ↑I.card *
                                    (∑ i ∈ I,
                                        ∫ (η : ℕ → Ω), ‖gradient f (T.vertex gamma x0 g η (T.auxNode m i))‖ ^ 2 ∂↑P +
                                      σ ^ 2)
